pairs.subject: remote-capability-probing
pairs.evidence: app/data/snapshot.json/route.ts:14 I searched app/admin, app/atlas and app/data for range, content-range, accept-ranges, partial, probe, capabilit, fetch( and 206 and found no matches. These files only read the local embedded store (via loaders, cookies and an append-only drive log) and serve whole JSON documents. None of them reads from a remote store they don't administer, so the subject's precondition (deciding whether a peer supports fragment reads) is never met.

techniques.evidence: app/data/snapshot.json/route.ts:14 The payload comes from a local loader. No peer capability header is read.
app/atlas/atlas.json/route.ts:13 This is a local store read, so no remote probe or first read happens.
app/data/snapshot.json/route.ts:26 The route serves a whole object it built itself. No fallback turns a fragment read into a whole-object fetch.
